data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then a mail draft that is discarded), but it has two problems: it lists director, runtime, rating and score as input parameters when they are values read from the sites, and it has a single "recipient email" parameter instead of a friend name that is used in both the address and the "Hi {friend}" greeting; it also gives no exact body template and leaves out the tab switching and the "do not send" detail, so an automation built from it would need guesses.
